digest.en: The U.S. Senate is expected to confirm Jay Clayton as the next Intelligence Director, amidst ongoing global intelligence operations. Meanwhile, Central Asian countries are seeking alternate trade routes due to the Iran War, as they increasingly look beyond Iran for economic partnerships. Uganda has begun emergency food handouts after 19 people died from hunger.
